## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login now works end to end on staging with Fernhill's IdP, after the RelayState fix (6d0e2b8). Fernhill's test user signs in and is created as `viewer` through JIT provisioning. Group-to-role mapping (`Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins` → `admin`, default `viewer`) is committed as f4a91c7 and is in PR #421, which is still open. PR #415 (JIT provisioning) is merged. The tests passed (1301 passed, 3 skipped). The work is blocked on Fernhill adding the groups claim before the Thursday demo. (source: ses-sso-3, s3-04, s3-06, s3-09, 6d0e2b8, f4a91c7, kestrel-analytics/platform#415, kestrel-analytics/platform#421, src-linear-kes311)

- [en-cours] PR #421 (group-to-role mapping and short RelayState) is open, not merged. (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#421, f4a91c7)
- [en-cours] Waiting on Fernhill IT to add the `groups` claim to their assertion. Daniel is emailing them. (source: s3-05, src-linear-kes311)
- [prochaine-étape] Once the groups claim exists, create one admin test account and use `kestrel.test1` for the demo on Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 ET. (source: s3-08, src-linear-kes311)
- [essai-raté] The first JIT test run failed because the email domain case did not match the lowercase domain list. Fixed by normalizing to lowercase. (source: s2-02)
- [essai-raté] The full return URL (143 bytes) as RelayState was rejected by Fernhill's ADFS, which caps it at 80 bytes (MSIS7042). Replaced with a 22-character opaque ID stored in Redis for 10 minutes. (source: s3-02, s3-04)
- [question] Fernhill IT's Slack message asks for IdP-initiated login only and the `analyst` default role. Neither is in the team's decisions, and `analyst` does not exist yet. (source: src-slack-fernhill, s3-07)
- [question] An internal note says SSO enforcement with password login disabled is planned for Dec 1. It is not confirmed by a team source. (source: src-note-enforce)
- [décision] Default role stays `viewer`, and SP-initiated login stays on for this tenant. (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Users are created at first login with the `viewer` role. (source: s1-05)
- [décision] SAML only for Fernhill, no OIDC for now. (source: s1-03)
- [décision] No account is created from an unverified domain, even if the IdP sends one. (source: s2-03)
